country.evidence_quote: In 1973, the first modern Lidl location opened in Ludwigshafen, Germany. With only three employees and around 500 products, this tiny store was the humble beginning of our global expansion. We started opening stores outside of Germany in the 1990s, and within a few years, we were all over Europe!
